review_kind: author-side independent standard-library evidence and arithmetic audit

timing.scope: Freeze checks, four registered probes, handle cleanup, readback and per-case publication. Final RESULTS publication is separate.

final_timing.scope: Qualification including RESULTS write/close. This timing receipt publication is separate.

qualification.publication_scope: Both pre-summary and including-RESULTS intervals retained. FINAL_TIMING self-publication unmeasured.

primary.batch_window: From run() entry before first integrity/reservation through common parent setup, per-run preparation, source verification, progress and summary analysis. Controller startup/standard-library imports/initial freeze read and final self-publication are outside this batch window and explicitly unmeasured. Each primary child window includes its full startup/import.
primary.cold_scope: Fresh processes with empty application image caches. OS caches untouched.
primary.primary_end: After process exit and full result, PNG, NPZ and trace reads plus image and counter validation.
primary.primary_start: Immediately before Popen, after output directory allocation and frozen hash verification.

scope.batch: Whole batch starts at run() entry before first integrity/reservation. Controller process startup, standard-library imports and initial FROZEN JSON read are unmeasured. Primary per-child timing includes that child startup and all imports.
scope.cold_scope: Fresh processes with empty application image caches. OS caches untouched.
scope.text_bytes: UTF-8 result, publication, TRACE and frame JSON plus stdout/stderr files.
scope.array_payload: Uncompressed .npy data bytes decoded and hashed from existing NPZ. RSS unmeasured.
scope.model_consumption: No model/provider/Blender/API test. Local PNG receipts only.
scope.audit_method: Existing JSON/JSONL, raw file bytes and .npy headers only. No experiment or product imports.
unknown: Controller process startup, stdlib imports and initial FROZEN read
Final batch summary and qualification FINAL_TIMING self-publication
